# The required Attribute

#### Course: Learn HTML

## The required Attribute

The required attribute specifies that an input field must be filled out before submitting the form.

It is supported by fields such as text, email, password, checkbox, radio, select and textarea.

Let's see an example.

```html
1<form>
2  <label for="username">Username:</label>
3  <input type="text" name="username" required><br>
4
5  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
6</form>
```

Browser Output (after clicking Submit with empty field)
